issue: Prior derived canonical materializations could contribute product IDs to processed-union coverage even though they were already excluded from latest-live canonical status. This allowed later current-delta products summarized by an older audit artifact to leak into the fixed 2026-08-27 cut coverage count.
expected_policy: Only raw live OCR evidence may establish historical-cut processed coverage; diagnostic replay wrappers and derived canonical materializations remain auditable but do not add product IDs to the fixed-cut processed union.
